tiles.name: Overlapping cheque books
tiles.sql:
WITH books AS (
  SELECT branch, account,
         TO_NUMBER(first_check_no) AS first_no,
         check_leaves,
         TO_NUMBER(first_check_no) + check_leaves AS next_start_no,
         order_date
  FROM   catm_check_book
),
chained AS (
  SELECT b.*,
         MAX(next_start_no) OVER (
           PARTITION BY account
           ORDER BY first_no, order_date
           ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
         ) AS prior_next_start_no
  FROM   books b
)
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM   chained
WHERE  first_no < prior_next_start_no
